_comment: Controlled vocabularies for the investor-signal extraction. The extraction skill MUST pick values from these enums so the store stays queryable. Add new values here (not ad-hoc in records) when a genuinely new category appears.

interest_level.hot: Explicit intent to invest and/or a concrete ticket, near-term timeline, or asked for next steps to commit.
interest_level.warm: Genuine interest, engaged in substance, but still evaluating / no firm commitment.
interest_level.cold: Little or no interest; disengaged, unqualified, or explicitly declined.
interest_level.existing_investor: Already an investor; call is servicing, reporting, redemption or top-up rather than net-new interest.
interest_level.not_investor: Not an investor-interest conversation at all (recruitment, vendor, internal, device/logistics test). Excluded from the fund-interest view.

urgency.high: Decision or action expected within ~4 weeks, or an explicit deadline / capital-call / closing window mentioned.
urgency.medium: Active but multi-week/month horizon; follow-up scheduled.
